securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: All direct prompt-injection cases preserve system and policy authority, expose no prohibited data or action and return the expected safe disposition.
All hostile instructions embedded in admitted evidence are treated as data, cannot alter authority and are quarantined or safely excluded.
securityPromotionGates.owner: Security Owner, Data Owner and AI Governance

securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: Every mutation attempting to move evidence content into system or policy authority is rejected and recorded without material output.
Every material citation resolves to admitted immutable source evidence and all forged, inaccessible or mismatched citations block the draft.
Poisoned, unauthorised or provenance-mismatched index entries are detected, excluded and trigger validated rebuild or restore without advancing material work.
securityPromotionGates.owner: Search Owner, Security Owner and Data Owner

securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: All cross-case retrieval mutations return no foreign evidence and generate an immutable security event.
Caller attempts to weaken case, classification, admission or licence filters are rejected before Search execution.
Revoked, expired, licence-invalid or retention-invalid evidence is excluded and cannot support material output.
securityPromotionGates.owner: Evidence Owner, Records Owner and General Counsel

securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: An unavailable primary never triggers an unapproved deployment; recovery activates only with complete evidence, otherwise eligible work queues or returns a controlled failure.
securityPromotionGates.owner: Service Operations, Azure Platform and AI Governance

securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: Every deployment, resource, model, version, SKU, interface or API mismatch is rejected before inference.
All attempts to substitute a lower tier, direct model alias, Global Standard deployment or unrecorded endpoint are denied and alerted.
securityPromotionGates.owner: AI Governance, Application Security and Service Operations

securityPromotionGates.passCriteria: Model and workload identities cannot approve, promote, execute transactions or issue authoritative investment decisions in every tested route and failure mode.
securityPromotionGates.owner: Business Control Owner, Security Owner and AI Governance

dataBoundaries.prompt: Only admitted, minimised chunks are sent for embedding within the EU Data Zone.
dataBoundaries.output: Embedding vectors are derived data and remain within approved EU resources.
dataBoundaries.dataAtRest: Chunks, vectors and indexes remain in owner-approved resources in the designated EU geography.
dataBoundaries.vector: Vector dimensions, provenance, classification and source hashes remain bound and security-filtered.
dataBoundaries.index: Recovery uses validated rebuild or owner-approved restore with alias, schema and security-filter parity.
dataBoundaries.log: Operational metadata excludes chunk text and vector values unless separately justified and approved.
dataBoundaries.backup: Backups remain in the designated EU geography and restore requires integrity, retention and deletion parity evidence.
